body: r30-org round 3 (2026-10-07): plugin/access was moved INTO the core module because plugin/admin (core module) now imports it for admin roles. This conflicts with the owner's module rule of 2026-10-02 (roles/permissions are not authentication, so they get their own module even with no dependency). Options: (a) keep access in core (stdlib only, no new dependency); (b) move admin role support into a separate module, e.g. plugin/admin/roles, so the core admin plugin keeps only the staff flag. Owner to decide. Also: the admin flag maps to an 'admin' role; admin_role column added.
